privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: At Tarif Ai, we place great importance on our users' privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and share data within the app.
privacy.dataCollectionText: Tarif Ai follows a minimal data collection principle:
privacy.noPersonalData: We Do Not Collect Personal Data
privacy.dataUsageText: Tarif Ai runs on-device to enhance your experience. Recipe history or personal preferences remain stored locally on your device.
privacy.dataSecurityText: Tarif Ai implements necessary technical safeguards to keep your information secure. Because the app can run offline, data sharing stays at a minimum.
privacy.policyChangesText: Any changes to this privacy policy will be announced alongside app updates.
privacy.contactText: For questions or feedback about this privacy policy, reach us at tarifaiapp@gmail.com.
